content.overview: Section 27 treats specified persons as the owner of house property for sections 22 to 26, including a transfer to a spouse or minor child and the holder of an impartible estate.
content.glance: Section 27 treats specified persons as the owner of house property for sections 22 to 26, including a transfer to a spouse or minor child and the holder of an impartible estate.
content.study: For the house-property head, an individual who transfers property to a spouse or minor child otherwise than for adequate consideration, the holder of an impartible estate, and a member of a co-operative society or company to whom a building is allotted, are treated as the owner.

sections.heading: Operative rule
sections.body: Section 27 treats specified persons as the owner of house property for sections 22 to 26, including a transfer to a spouse or minor child and the holder of an impartible estate.
